```yaml
name: Agentic Diagnostics - Safe Inputs & MCP Gateway

on:
  push:
    paths:
      - 'docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md'
      - 'docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json'
      - '.github/workflows/agentic-diagnostics.yml'
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - 'docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md'
      - 'docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json'
      - '.github/workflows/agentic-diagnostics.yml'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  security-events: write

jobs:
  validate-safe-inputs-schema:
    name: Validate Safe Inputs JSON Schema
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate JSON Schema Syntax
        run: |
          echo "Checking if schema is valid JSON..."
          jq empty docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json
          echo "Schema is valid JSON."

      - name: Validate Schema Structure
        run: |
          echo "Checking required schema properties..."
          jq -e '.properties.toolName' docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json > /dev/null
          jq -e '.properties.implementation' docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json > /dev/null
          jq -e '.properties.inputs' docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json > /dev/null
          echo "Core properties present."

      - name: Validate Tool Name Regex Constraint
        run: |
          echo "Checking toolName pattern constraint..."
          jq -e '.properties.toolName.pattern == "^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$"' docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json > /dev/null
          echo "Tool name regex constraint verified."

      - name: Validate Implementation OneOf Constraint
        run: |
          echo "Checking implementation oneOf constraint..."
          jq -e '.properties.implementation.oneOf | length == 4' docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json > /dev/null
          echo "Implementation oneOf constraint verified (4 types)."

      - name: Validate Environment Variable Pattern
        run: |
          echo "Checking environment variable pattern..."
          jq -e '.definitions.envVar.pattern == "^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$"' docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json > /dev/null || \
          jq -e '.properties.environment.items.pattern == "^[A-Z_][A-Z0-9_]*$"' docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json > /dev/null
          echo "Environment variable pattern verified."

  validate-specification-content:
    name: Validate Safe Inputs Specification Content
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check Specification Version
        run: |
          echo "Checking specification version..."
          grep -q "Version: 1.1.0" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          echo "Version 1.1.0 found."

      - name: Check W3C Structure Keywords
        run: |
          echo "Checking for RFC 2119 keywords..."
          grep -q "MUST" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          grep -q "SHALL" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          grep -q "SHOULD" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          grep -q "MAY" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          echo "RFC 2119 keywords present."

      - name: Check Core Sections
        run: |
          echo "Checking for core sections..."
          grep -q "Architecture" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          grep -q "Configuration" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          grep -q "Execution" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          grep -q "Language Support" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          grep -q "Security" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          grep -q "MCP Gateway" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          echo "Core sections present."

      - name: Check Compliance Test Cases
        run: |
          echo "Checking for compliance test cases..."
          # Check for dependency test cases
          grep -q "T-DEP-001" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          grep -q "T-DEP-006" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          # Check for security test cases
          grep -q "T-SEC-007" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          grep -q "T-SEC-008" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          echo "Compliance test cases present."

      - name: Check Security Enhancements
        run: |
          echo "Checking for security enhancements..."
          grep -q "Dependency Security" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          grep -q "GitHub Actions Integration Security" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          echo "Security enhancements present."

      - name: Check GitHub Actions Integration Example
        run: |
          echo "Checking for GitHub Actions integration example..."
          grep -q "Appendix A.5" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          grep -q "PR complexity analysis" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          echo "GitHub Actions integration example present."

  validate-mcp-gateway-extensibility:
    name: Validate MCP Gateway Extensibility
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Check MCP Gateway Custom Server Types
        run: |
          echo "Checking for MCP Gateway custom server types support..."
          grep -q "custom server types" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md || \
          grep -q "specialized implementations" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          echo "MCP Gateway extensibility documented."

      - name: Check Configuration Extensibility
        run: |
          echo "Checking for configuration extensibility..."
          grep -q "configuration extensibility" docs/src/content/docs/reference/safe-inputs-specification.md
          echo "Configuration extensibility documented."

  security-audit:
    name: Security Audit
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Harden Runner
        uses: step-security/harden-runner@20cf305ff2072d973412fa9b1e3a4f227bda3c76
        with:
          egress-policy: audit
          disable-sudo: true

      - name: Run zizmor
        uses: zizmorcore/zizmor-action@135698455da5c3b3e55f73f4419e481ab68cdd95
        with:
          config: .github/zizmor.yaml
          online-audits: true
          min-severity: warning
          fail-on-no-inputs: true

  integration-test:
    name: Integration Test - Safe Inputs Examples
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: [validate-safe-inputs-schema, validate-specification-content]
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: '1.21'

      - name: Validate Example Configurations
        run: |
          echo "Validating example configurations against schema..."
          # Create a test script to validate examples if they exist in the repo
          if [ -d "docs/examples" ]; then
            for example in docs/examples/*.yaml; do
              echo "Validating $example..."
              # Use a simple validation approach
              cat "$example" | yq -e '.' > /dev/null
            done
          fi
          echo "Example validation complete."

      - name: Test Schema Validation with dsanders11
        uses: dsanders11/json-schema-validate-action@v1.4.0
        with:
          schema: docs/public/schemas/safe-inputs-config.schema.json
          files: docs/examples/*.yaml
          fail-on-invalid: true
          all-errors: true
        continue-on-error: true
```
